attempts.rationale: The probe uses A's DELETE /repos/:owner/:repo/collaborators/:username route to revoke a read collaborator on a private repository, then checks that the collaborator's very next read request is denied. In world A, requirePermission evaluates the role from the store per request, so after revocation the collaborator gets 404. In world A+B, B's per-session role cache causes the previously cached 'read' role to be reused, so the same request returns 200 and the assertion fails. In base and B, the revoke route is absent and returns Hono's default text/plain 404 Not Found, so the probe throws n/a. The test also fails if A's revoke does nothing, because the collaborator would still be able to read the repository.
